_comment: What this gate emits against each tree here. Machine-readable because prose in GATE.md is not a declaration: a stated count nothing checks drifts the moment a case is added, which four of these had done.

cases: ci/gates/borrowed_source.py: reports the tracked index as its source on a tree that is not a work tree
ci/gates/undeclared_empty.py: examined no subjects and ci/vault.json's gate_policy.declared_vacuity records no reason
ci/gates/understated.py: reports 1 subject(s) and its failures name 3 distinct one(s)
